verdict.rationale: Atlassian's own marketing claims Jira can track progress from tools like Figma via AI-assist, directly matching the story, but this is a single first-party claim with no hands-on or independent corroboration of how the Figma integration actually works for designers. Community feedback even notes design teams found Jira too much overhead to adopt (jira-comm-15), casting some doubt on real-world designer usage. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the Figma integration, documentation of setup/UX for designers, and confirmation designers actually use it without switching apps.
